model: PATEK PHILIPPE Aquanaut Chronograph 5968A-001 (42.2 mm steel, black and orange embossed dial, black rubber strap)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot (at hand height). Aquanaut Chronograph 5968A-001 (catalog 2 row 110): the Aquanaut template (case slab from the alpha silhouette, superellipse bezel ring with scanned window and chamfer, flat polygon dial with the native photo map, one fluted crown, one-piece rubber strap) plus the chronograph parts: two pusher prisms at 2 / 4 o'clock, the central orange chronograph hand with its long tail, the sub-dial hand at 6 o'clock with its own pivot, orange hubs. Scale 30.09 px/mm anchored on the left flank (21.1 mm from the pivot). Step: pipeline/steps/watch_patek_aquanaut5968.py.

case.note: case slab = silhouette between the lug tips (tip_top / tip_bottom, 0.25 mm grid, sum a multiple of 0.25) with the crown rows replaced by a straight line, top and bottom sloping toward the strap; bezel = superellipse ring (min of the superellipse and the silhouette less silhouette_margin_mm, sampled by rays) at bezel_z, then a chamfer ring down to the dial window at chamfer_z

dial.note: flat polygon (the window less the chamfer) with the native photo map: embossed grid, applied numerals, indices, minute track, date window and the photographed hands stay in the map

hands.note: profile = [mm along the hand from the pivot (negative = tail), half width] from tail to tip, last point at the traced length; measured on this photo (hour 303.26, minute 52.74, central chronograph hand 0.30, sub-dial hand 137.87 deg; centre-line offsets and the sub-dial pivot in the trace). lume = [s, half width] of the pale inlay. Hour / minute hands, grey hub: hands_photo; orange chronograph hands and hubs: hands_orange (the reference photo projected from the front).

crown.note: crowns come from trace.crowns: a lathe about the axis (profile = [radius, mm along the axis] from the base point), flutes are texture

strap.note: strap.kind rubber, ONE full-width piece: edges = trace.strap_y_left_right_mm (silhouette outside the lug zone, measured lug inner walls inside it), from under the bezel to the rounded ends; the embossed grid pad of the photo is texture only

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass

pusher.note: polygon prisms from the photo silhouette at the 2 and 4 o'clock rows (trace.pushers), closed under the case; the photo is projected on them like on every steel part
